about: Diagram cases both cores check: an SVG (inline, a file here, or `parts`: text repeated count times, joined), and null when it is drawn or the exact reason it is refused.

cases.name: escaped text
cases.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><text x="1" y="5">a < b & c</text></svg>

cases.name: an entity
cases.refused: A diagram takes no DOCTYPE or entities.
cases.svg: <!DOCTYPE svg [<!ENTITY a "x">]><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><text x="1" y="5">&a;</text></svg>

cases.name: a doctype
cases.refused: A diagram takes no DOCTYPE or entities.

cases.name: an undeclared entity
cases.refused: The diagram isn't well-formed XML.

cases.name: unclosed
cases.refused: The diagram isn't well-formed XML.

cases.name: mismatched tags
cases.refused: The diagram isn't well-formed XML.

cases.name: a second root
cases.refused: The diagram isn't well-formed XML.

cases.name: a processing instruction
cases.refused: A diagram takes no processing instructions.

cases.name: a use that brings itself in
cases.refused: `<use>` brings in `#a` inside itself.

cases.name: uses that bring each other in
cases.refused: `<use>` brings in `#a` inside itself.
cases.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><defs><g id="a"><use href="#b"/></g><g id="b"><use href="#a"/></g></defs><use href="#a"/></svg>

cases.name: nesting past the limit
cases.refused: The diagram nests deeper than 16 levels. Flatten its groups.

cases.name: a non-finite number
cases.refused: `width` must be a finite number; it is “1e999”.

cases.name: a non-finite path number
cases.refused: `d` on `<path>`: numbers must be finite.

cases.name: not a number
cases.refused: `x` must be a finite number; it is “ten”.

cases.name: over 64 KB
cases.refused: The diagram is 67268 bytes; the limit is 65536. Draw less, or split it into cards.

cases.name: too many elements
cases.refused: The diagram has more than 2000 elements. Draw less, or split it into cards.

cases.name: too many use copies
cases.refused: The diagram draws more than 2000 elements, `use` copies included. Draw less.
cases.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><defs><rect id="l0" width="1" height="1"/><g id="l1"><use href="#l0"/><use href="#l0"/><use href="#l0"/><use href="#l0"/><use href="#l0"/><use href="#l0"/><use href="#l0"/><use href="#l0"/><use href="#l0"/><use href="#l0"/></g><g id="l2"><use href="#l1"/><use href="#l1"/><use href="#l1"/><use href="#l1"/><use href="#l1"/><use href="#l1"/><use href="#l1"/><use href="#l1"/><use href="#l1"/><use href="#l1"/></g><g id="l3"><use href="#l2"/><use href="#l2"/><use href="#l2"/><use href="#l2"/><use href="#l2"/><use href="#l2"/><use href="#l2"/><use href="#l2"/><use href="#l2"/><use href="#l2"/></g><g id="l4"><use href="#l3"/><use href="#l3"/><use href="#l3"/><use href="#l3"/><use href="#l3"/><use href="#l3"/><use href="#l3"/><use href="#l3"/><use href="#l3"/><use href="#l3"/></g></defs><use href="#l4"/></svg>

cases.name: an external href
cases.refused: `<use>` takes an `href` to an element of the diagram (`#id`).

cases.name: a missing use target
cases.refused: `<use>` names `#nope`, which the diagram doesn't have.

cases.name: a viewBox of zero width
cases.refused: Give the diagram a `viewBox` with a width and height above 0.

cases.name: a negative viewBox
cases.refused: Give the diagram a `viewBox` with a width and height above 0.

cases.name: a viewBox of three numbers
cases.refused: `viewBox` takes four numbers: x y width height.

cases.name: no size at all
cases.refused: Give the diagram a `viewBox` (or `width` and `height`) with a width and height above 0.

cases.name: not an svg
cases.refused: A diagram is one `<svg>` element; this starts with `<g>`.

cases.name: an image
cases.refused: `<image>` isn't drawn. A diagram draws shapes and text only.

cases.name: a gradient element
cases.refused: `<linearGradient>` isn't drawn. Fills are solid colors.

cases.name: css
cases.refused: `style` on `<rect>`: CSS isn't drawn: give `fill`, `stroke` and the rest as attributes.

cases.name: a gradient fill
cases.refused: `fill` is a gradient or pattern; fills are solid colors (`#rrggbb`).

cases.name: a named color
cases.refused: `fill` is “red”: give a color as `#rrggbb`, `#rgb`, black, white or none.

cases.name: a short hex
cases.refused: `stroke` is “#12”: give a color as `#rrggbb` or `#rgb`.

cases.name: an unknown transform
cases.refused: `transform` has “spin” with 1 numbers; it takes translate, scale, rotate, skewX, skewY or matrix.

cases.name: an unclosed transform
cases.refused: `transform` is missing a “)”.

cases.name: a bad path command
cases.refused: `d` on `<path>`: “X” isn't a path command.

cases.name: a path without M
cases.refused: `d` on `<path>`: it must start with a command (M).

cases.name: an empty path
cases.refused: `d` on `<path>`: it is empty.

cases.name: bad arc flags
cases.refused: `d` on `<path>`: an arc's flags are 0 or 1.

cases.name: a marker-end on no marker
cases.refused: `marker-end` names `#a`, which isn't a `<marker>` of the diagram.

cases.name: a marker-end without url
cases.refused: `marker-end` takes `url(#id)` naming a `<marker>` of the diagram.

cases.name: text with markup
cases.refused: `<text>` holds plain text only; one `<text>` per line.

cases.name: a percentage
cases.refused: `width` is a percentage; give it in the viewBox's units.

cases.name: a negative rect
cases.refused: A `<rect>` has a negative size.

cases.name: one point
cases.refused: `points` on `<polyline>` takes pairs of numbers, at least two points.

cases.name: a bad linecap
cases.refused: `stroke-linecap` is butt, round or square.

cases.name: a bad font weight
cases.refused: `font-weight` is normal, bold or a number.

cases.name: a zero font size
cases.refused: `font-size` must be above 0.

cases.name: a marker without id
cases.refused: A `<marker>` needs an `id` for `marker-end` to name it.

cases.name: a marker of zero size
cases.refused: A marker needs a `markerWidth` and `markerHeight` above 0.
cases.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><defs><marker id="m" markerWidth="0"/></defs><line x2="5" marker-end="url(#m)"/></svg>

cases.name: bad marker units
cases.refused: `markerUnits` is strokeWidth or userSpaceOnUse.
cases.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><defs><marker id="m" markerUnits="px"/></defs><line x2="5" marker-end="url(#m)"/></svg>
